hints.text: The rule says how to get $y$ from $x$. Use the given $x$ in the rule.
$4x$ means $4$ times $x$, so with $x = 6$ you need to work out $4 \times 6$.
Four times six is $4 \times 6 = 24$, so $y$ equals $24$.

explanation: The equation $y = 4x$ says $y$ is four times $x$.
Replace $x$ with the given value $6$, which makes the rule $y = 4(6)$.
Multiplying gives $24$, so the answer is $y = 24$ when $x = 6$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Skip count by 4
steps: Four times $6$ is the sixth number you say when you skip count by $4$.
Saying the count out loud gives $4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24$.
The sixth number in the count is $24$, so $y = 24$.
